summary: Verified Disease Browser Panel on Differential Diagnosis + Core Engine pages and PDF Export dropdown/download on Food Analysis page. All 9 target features PASS. Discovered one UX bug: multiple 'Other' rows in DiseaseBrowserPanel due to grouping-vs-label mismatch.

ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar shows 7+ rows all labeled 'Other' (counts 221, 122, 117, 80, 70, 23, 15, 15, 15). Root cause: grouping uses `disease.category?.toLowerCase()` as the group KEY, but CATEGORY_CONFIG only maps 15 known keys; unknown categories keep their unique lowercase key (so become separate groups) yet fall back to CATEGORY_CONFIG.other which sets label='Other' for all of them. Fix: either (a) normalize unknown categories to a single 'other' key before grouping, or (b) use the original category string as the label when config falls back to default. Total across the 7 'Other' rows equals ~558 diseases that are effectively unclassified.

verifications.select_disease_adds_to_clinical_text: PASS - Clicking a disease appended 'Condition: <name> (ICD-10: N/A)' into the Clinical Text textarea, switched to Clinical Text tab, closed sidebar, and showed success toast.
verifications.core_engine_browse_all_button: PASS - /dashboard [data-testid=disease-browser-toggle] labeled 'Browse All' opens the same sidebar with 2,568 diseases and 46 category groups.
verifications.food_export_pdf_dropdown: PASS - After analyzing 'apple' on /food, Export PDF dropdown shows: Download PDF, Share..., Share via Email, Share via WhatsApp.

verifications.body_map_organ_positions: PASS (verified in iteration_10) - liver cx=75 (patient RIGHT), stomach cx=115 (patient LEFT), spleen cx=130 (patient LEFT), heart cx=105.

action_items: Fix DiseaseBrowserPanel.js grouping so unknown categories collapse into a single 'Other' bucket (or use the original category string as the label). Currently ~558 diseases appear as 7 duplicate 'Other' rows.
Optional: category strings returned by /api/diseases-db/list should be normalized on the backend to the 15 canonical CATEGORY_CONFIG keys to avoid this class of bug entirely.
critical_code_review_comments: DiseaseBrowserPanel.js: category key logic is fragile - config lookup and group key must use the same normalization.
DashboardMultiScale.js is >4600 lines - continues to warrant a refactor split (already flagged in iteration_10).
DifferentialPage.js is >2550 lines - same maintainability concern.
PDFExportButton.jsx uses `window.location.href = mailto:...` for email share which can navigate the SPA away; consider window.open with _blank.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested features PASS (1 minor UX bug found)
